adamantium-claw-berserker.alt: Snappy with the claws tucked away -- does it hurt when they come out? Every time. The hotkey never does.

adamantium-claw-berserker-nsfw.alt: Snappy, claws out -- two hundred years old, heals from anything, and still never found a faster launcher.

aftershave-scream-face.alt: Snappy alone with the aftershave -- it made its family disappear, and the mouse right after. Only the hotkey stays.

air-guitar-phone-booth.alt: Snappy shredding air guitar by a time-travelling phone booth -- be excellent to each other, and party on with hotkeys!

air-guitar-phone-booth-blond-mane.alt: Snappy tows a historical figure through the booth -- book that launch, dude, it's worth extra credit.

alien-couple-plush-grump-hug.alt: Snappy squeezing its grumpy other half -- fled a dying planet together, crash-landed in the suburbs, still fighting over the hotkey.

armless-plumed-knight-flesh-wound-nsfw.alt: Snappy's armour lies in pieces around it -- 'tis but a scratch. The launcher has had worse.

armored-unicycle-hero.alt: Snappy on one big wheel -- blathering blatherskite, that launch was quick!

art-deco-helmet-jetpack.alt: Snappy with a rocket pack and a finned helmet -- the leak is patched with chewing gum, cleared for launch.

astronaut.alt: Snappy floating past the porthole -- Houston, this app has a green light to launch.

atomic-breath-kaiju-king.alt: Snappy stomps through a tiny city -- the king of launchers has arrived.

automail-fire-alchemist.alt: Snappy bound by equivalent exchange -- one command given, one app launched.

aviator-flight-jacket.alt: Snappy checking six with mirrored shades on -- it feels the need, the need for launch speed.

ay-yi-yi-robot-assistant.alt: Snappy flailing at the teleporter console -- ay-yi-yi-yi-yi! Five teenagers with attitude incoming, and the app isn't open yet!

azure-veil-princess.alt: Snappy, the emperor's adopted princess -- it learned who really killed its father and switched sides. To the hotkey.

azure-veil-princess-nsfw.alt: Snappy, fans open -- one sweep lifts the mouse into the air and holds it there. Plenty of time to press the hotkey.

bald-bat-ear-count-rat-nsfw.alt: Snappy creeping in from the silent film -- the ship has landed, and so has a very fast launcher.

bald-black-robe-butterfly-net.alt: Snappy, net on the shoulder -- the mushroom village stays hidden, the little blue pests escape, the hotkey never does.

bald-lollipop-sunglasses.alt: Snappy taps the lollipop against its beak -- who loves ya, launcher? This owl does, every single time.

bald-mind-helmet-wheelchair.alt: Snappy across the chessboard from its oldest friend -- always one move ahead, and one keystroke ahead of the mouse.

bald-uncle-lightbulb.alt: Snappy back after twenty-five years lost in the Bermuda Triangle -- forgot the whole family, remembered the hotkey.

banana-goggle-minion.alt: Snappy armed with a banana -- LAUNCH! BA-NA-NA!

bandaged-head-dark-glasses.alt: Snappy tipping its hat to nobody in particular -- an invisible launcher can rule the world. Nobody sees it come, nobody sees it go.

bandaged-pharaoh-unravelling.alt: Snappy wrapped for three thousand years -- it woke up, found one more roll, and launched anyway.

bark-suit-sprout-head.alt: Snappy in bark with a sprout on top -- I am launcher.

bathrobe-bowler.alt: Snappy sets the drink down -- this aggression will not stand, man. The dude has a hotkey.

battle-scarred-cyborg.alt: Snappy as a battle-damaged cyborg -- it'll be back. With a launch command.

battle-scarred-cyborg-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy, shades on, half its face torn open -- hasta la vista, mouse.

battle-scarred-cyborg-nsfw.alt: Snappy as a relentless machine -- I need your launcher, your commands, and your torch.

beagle-ace-doghouse-pilot.alt: Snappy on the red doghouse -- curse you, slow launcher!

bearskin-hat-walnut-soldier.alt: Snappy saluting at midnight -- the tree grows, the toys wake up, and the seven-headed mouse loses to one hotkey.

beep-beep-purple-desert-sprinter.alt: Snappy gone in a puff of dust -- meep meep! The app launched before anyone could open the mail-order catalogue.

beige-jumpsuit-ghost-trap.alt: Snappy with a ghost trap -- back off, man, this owl is a scientist. Of launching.

big-glasses-red-bowtie-kid.alt: Snappy, big glasses, small body -- one pill shrank it back to first grade. One hotkey launches the app all the same.

bird-headed-feathered-warrior-friend.alt: Snappy standing stiffly at its own wedding -- the guests turn out to be agents, the toast goes badly, and the app still launches on cue.

black-beehive-gown-horror-hostess.alt: Snappy lounging on the chaise with popcorn -- unpleasant dreams, and pleasant launches.

black-braids-pet-hand.alt: Snappy, never blinking -- no smiles, no mouse clicks, just that stiff little dance when the app launches.

black-coat-shades.alt: Snappy after taking the red pill -- there is no launcher.

black-coat-shades-2.alt: Snappy hanging up the payphone -- a world without menus, without mouse clicks. Where it goes from there is one hotkey away.

black-coat-shades-3.alt: Snappy inside the construct -- the agents are very much aware of the launcher.

black-digger-molehill-hello.alt: Snappy up out of the dirt -- all it ever wanted was trousers with two big pockets. One for the hotkey, one for the app.

black-dragon-gummy-grin-plasma.alt: Snappy flashes a wide gummy, toothless grin over the fish -- retract the fangs, extend the launch.

black-face-woolly-sheep.alt: Snappy with a cheeky thumbs-up -- the farmer is asleep, so the flock takes over the launcher.

black-helmet-heavy-breathing.alt: Snappy, breathing heavily -- it finds your lack of hotkeys disturbing. Come to the dark side, we have cookies.

black-helmet-heavy-breathing-nsfw.alt: Snappy, red blade lowered -- no... it is your launcher. Search your feelings, you know it to be true.

black-mask-cape-swordsman-of-california.alt: Snappy tipping its flat black hat -- three quick slashes, and the mark on the post says the launch was here.

black-mask-cape-swordsman-of-california-.alt: Snappy with the rapier raised -- three quick slashes on the post, and a Z for every launch.

black-spandex-dino-dancer.alt: Snappy in black striking a dance pose -- it's morphin' time, and dance time, and launch time.

black-suit-earpiece-agent.alt: Snappy, earpiece pressed -- it's the smell of the mouse. It can't stand it. The hotkey is cleaner.

bladed-helmet-armor-master.alt: Snappy in a horned samurai helmet -- its clan lost to four green brothers again, but its launches win every time.

bladed-helmet-armor-master-nsfw.alt: Snappy crossing its arm blades -- its plans fail every single week, but the hotkey cuts through anyway.

blond-bowl-cut-harness.alt: Snappy raises its fist -- by the power of the hotkey, I have the launcher.

blond-bowl-cut-harness-nsfw.alt: Snappy thrusts the sword skyward -- I have the power! Lightning for the transformation, one hotkey for the launch.

blue-alien-cloak-hates-earth.alt: Snappy checking the mission list -- protect the baby, fix the ship, leave this idiot planet. Step four: the hotkey.

blue-armour-rose-umbrella-cat.alt: Snappy with a rose and a red umbrella -- the charmer of the pizza team delivers the hotkey with style.

blue-arrow-glider-monk.alt: Snappy on the glider staff -- a hundred years frozen in an iceberg, and the first thing it asks for is a hotkey. Yip yip!

blue-bandana-leader-shell-hero.alt: Snappy pointing the way -- someone has to lead the four brothers, and it leads with the hotkey.

blue-fur-cookie-baker.alt: Snappy in a chef's hat with a fresh tray -- what is love? Love is warm cookie and fast launch.

blue-fur-cookie-crumbs.alt: Snappy, crumbs flying everywhere -- me want cookie! Om nom nom... no, not browser cookie. Me want hotkey!

blue-fur-cookie-jar.alt: Snappy hugging a cookie jar -- today's launch is brought to you by the letter C and the number one hotkey.

blue-fur-cookie-tower.alt: Snappy balancing a tower of cookies -- one cookie? Me no stop at one. Me launch them all!

blue-jacket-garden-rabbit.alt: Snappy slipping out of the vegetable patch -- jacket still on, carrot launched before the gardener looks up.

blue-plush-elephant-hug.alt: Snappy hugging the manual again -- was it needle, haystack or haystack, needle? The launcher never has to look it up.

blue-qipao-ox-horn-buns.alt: Snappy, one leg up -- the lightning kick wants you to mash the key. The launcher only wants you to press it once.

blue-quills-gold-ring.alt: Snappy tapping its foot, ring in hand -- leave it idle too long and it starts tapping at you, so just hit the hotkey.

blue-robe-wizard-owl-familiar.alt: Snappy, an owl with its own grumpy owl -- higitus figitus, zumbabazing! The whole app list packs itself.

blue-screen-sad-face-crash.alt: Snappy with swirling eyes -- your launcher ran into a problem and needs to restart. Just kidding, press the hotkey.

blue-spandex-dino-genius.alt: Snappy in blue with a gadget -- the brains of the team calculates: one hotkey, zero delay.

blue-spiky-hair-lab-coat-green-gun-scien.alt: Snappy with the green-fluid gun and a hip flask -- wubba lubba dub dub! One shot, and the app opens in another dimension.

blue-spiky-hair-lab-coat-pointing-scient.alt: Snappy with a raised finger -- it turned itself into a launcher! Funniest thing it's ever seen.

boldly-go-gold.alt: Snappy on a five-year mission -- to boldly launch where no owl has launched before.

boldly-go-gold-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy flipping open the communicator -- beam me up. There is... an app... to launch.

boldly-go-gold-nsfw.alt: Snappy on the bridge -- set phasers to launch.

bolted-neck-monster.alt: Snappy freshly stitched and bolted -- it's alive! Mouse bad. Hotkey good.

bowler-mustache-medical-bag-chronicler.alt: Snappy taking notes on the case -- elementary, it says. It writes the launch up for the next story anyway.

brain-in-belly-android.alt: Snappy in a homemade cardboard robot -- the felt brain in the belly gives the orders, the body just presses the hotkey.

brass-porthole-diving-guardian-nsfw.alt: Snappy, drill spinning, portholes red -- would you kindly press the hotkey? An owl chooses, a mouse obeys.

brave-little-astromech.alt: Snappy as a brave little astromech -- beeping urgently, because the launch plans are inside.

brown-mouse-cheese-wedge.alt: Snappy, dragging cheese to the hole in the wall -- the one mouse that always wins. The cat should have used a hotkey.

bubble-dome-flailing-robot.alt: Snappy flailing its accordion arms -- danger! Danger! A mouse is approaching. Use the hotkey!

bulbous-green-poet-bureaucrat.alt: Snappy reciting from the form -- oh freddled gruntbuggly, thy launches are to me as plurdled hotkeys.

bumbling-trench-magnifier.alt: Snappy at the hotel desk -- 'does your mouse bite?' 'No.' Ouch. 'That is not my mouse.' Hotkey it is, then.

bureaucrat-dreadlocks-limbo.alt: Snappy under the limbo bar -- sweet manatee of Galilee, that launch went low and fast!

cape-and-fangs.alt: Snappy with centuries of thirst -- I vant to launch your applications.

cape-and-fangs-2.alt: Snappy rising at dusk -- the night is long and there are many apps to launch.

cardboard-box-infiltrator.alt: Snappy frozen under its box -- a guard turns, '!', then shrugs: just a box. Nobody saw the app launch.

cat-cradling-gold-android.alt: Snappy cradling its cat -- felis catus is its taxonomic nomenclature, and a hotkey is its launch procedure.

cat-in-box-both-states.alt: Snappy in the box, both states at once -- the app is launched and not launched until you press the hotkey and look.

century-hopper-red-vest.alt: Snappy, dared to launch -- nobody calls this owl chicken! One hotkey, no second thoughts.

century-hopper-walkie.alt: Snappy with a temporal gadget -- great Scott, this launch is from the future!

century-hopper-walkman.alt: Snappy rewinds the cassette one more time -- hit eighty-eight miles an hour, and this launch skips straight to the destination.

champagne-toast-tuxedo.alt: Snappy raising a glass under the fireworks -- old sport, that green light across the bay was a launch button all along.

checked-cap-blue-armchair-host.alt: Snappy, mayor of the whole village -- one snap of the feathers and the scene switches straight to your app.

christmas-thief-green-fur.alt: Snappy with a heart two sizes too small -- maybe a launch doesn't come from a store.

christmas-thief-santa-sack.alt: Snappy pausing mid-heist with a sly grin -- you're a mean one, but never too mean to launch.

chrome-battle-suit-blue-diamond.alt: Snappy with a giant blue gem, the title music booming out of the old home computer -- the first level loads, and so does the app.

chrome-battle-suit-lightning-whip-nsfw.alt: Snappy holding fire and swinging the lightning beam in a full circle -- every corner of the app list lit up in one sweep.

chrome-battle-suit-ribbed-gun-nsfw.alt: Snappy shooting open the next power-up block -- the single shot turns into a spread, the spread into a laser, and the laser into a hotkey.

chrome-battle-suit-victory-cheer.alt: Snappy throws both armored fists in the air -- level cleared, high score in, app launched.

chrome-bionic-arms-brawler.alt: Snappy flexing the chrome arms -- finish it! Flawless victory: one hotkey, zero clicks.

chrome-centurion.alt: Snappy as a chrome centurion with a sweeping red eye -- by your command, the app will launch.

chrome-centurion-nsfw.alt: Snappy as a red-eyed toaster packing heat -- all of this has launched before, and all of it will launch again.

chrome-officer-visor.alt: Snappy on Detroit patrol -- serve, protect, launch. Prime directive.

chrome-officer-visor-nsfw.alt: Snappy locked on a perp -- dead or alive, the app is launching with me.

cloak-and-lantern.alt: Snappy carrying double light -- because one torch is never enough.

cloak-and-mystic-eye.alt: Snappy in a floating cloak -- it viewed 14,000,605 futures, and in one the app launched on the first key.

cloak-and-torch.alt: Snappy on the long road -- the flame never goes out.

clues-were-elementary.alt: Snappy on the case -- the launch was elementary, dear user.

clues-were-elementary-2.alt: Snappy examining the evidence -- the game is afoot. So is the launcher.

clues-were-elementary-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy puffing thoughtfully on its pipe -- eliminate the impossible, and whatever remains, however improbable, is the hotkey.

clues-were-elementary-nsfw.alt: Snappy taps the unlit pipe thoughtfully -- the curious thing was the dog barking. Or not barking, not even once, before this launch.

colour-changing-alien-baby-blob.alt: Snappy as a rainbow alien baby -- it will terraform the planet one day. Today it just launches apps.

cosmic-surfer-silver.alt: Snappy riding a silver board through the cosmos -- herald of every app that needs launching.

crash-pilot-goggles-duck.alt: Snappy, goggles up, plane in the tree -- crashed every vehicle ever built, never crashed a launch. Ready when you are!

crouching-sweets-detective.alt: Snappy stacks another slice of cake onto the plate -- sugar first, then the forty percent chance the app launches on time.

crow-tengu-advisor-elder.alt: Snappy, one wing at the beard -- eh? Launch what? Speak up, sonny. Oh, the hotkey already did it.

crowbar-physicist.alt: Snappy with a crowbar at the ready -- rise and... shine. Is it really that... time again? The right app awaits.

crushed-velvet-frilly-cravat-spy.alt: Snappy, peace sign up -- somebody stole its mojo, but nobody touches its hotkey. Groovy, baby, yeah!

damn-fine-coffee.alt: Snappy speaking into a tiny recorder -- note to self, the launcher just opened itself again.

dashing-captain.alt: Snappy as an immortal charmer -- can't die, can't stop launching.

dashing-captain-banana.alt: Snappy reaching for the blaster and finding a banana -- someone swapped it again. Fine, the hotkey launches just as well.

dashing-captain-nsfw.alt: Snappy as an immortal rogue -- the 21st century is when everything launches.

daywalker-blade.alt: Snappy in shades at high noon -- all of their strengths, none of their weaknesses, and certainly no mouse.

daywalker-blade-nsfw.alt: Snappy as the daywalker -- some apps only get launched after dark.

daywalker-shades.alt: Snappy holding the coat open for the reveal -- the serum keeps the thirst down, the hotkey keeps the mouse away.

deadpan-badge-lampshade-mishap.alt: Snappy narrates its own day in flat deadpan -- there it was, another ordinary app, needing to be launched.

deadpan-badge-plate-umpire.alt: Snappy, undercover behind home plate -- steee-rike! It moonwalks, the crowd goes wild, and the app has launched.

deep-sea-diver.alt: Snappy diving to the depths -- launching from twenty thousand leagues under.

desert-face-wrapped-rider.alt: Snappy wrapped against the desert wind -- fear is the mind-killer. The mouse is the launch-killer.

desert-force-wielder.alt: Snappy at the bar, hood down -- you don't want to click through menus. You want to go home and rethink your life.

desert-force-wielder-2.alt: Snappy waving a wing at the stubborn mouse -- mind tricks don't work on it. Only the hotkey does.

desert-force-wielder-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy ignites the yellow blade beside its hood -- an elegant weapon, for a more civilized launch.

desert-force-wielder-nsfw.alt: Snappy waving a hand -- these aren't the apps you're looking for.

dino-kigurumi.alt: Snappy gone prehistoric -- life, uh, finds a way to launch.

dog-palace-guard-chief.alt: Snappy standing to attention -- nobody gets into the palace without the password. The hotkey walked straight in.

dome-head-bubble-robot-monitor.alt: Snappy serving on a tray -- at your service. Would you care for sixty gallons of hotkeys?

domino-mask-loot-sack-gang.alt: Snappy sneaking off with a bulging sack, shhh -- Ma says this is the big one. The getaway car is a hotkey.

donut-comb-over-nuclear.alt: Snappy on its safety break with a sprinkled donut -- mmm, hotkeys. Is there anything they can't do?

doomed-red-tunic-ensign.alt: Snappy beams down in the red shirt -- launches everything now, just in case.

dragon-trousers-wok-shout.alt: Snappy, thumb across the beak -- don't think, feel! Eight fist tournaments in, and the app still opens on one key.

dramatic-robot-soap-actor.alt: Snappy in gold robot armour, swooning -- the most dramatic launch in all of robot soap history!

dreadlock-hunter.alt: Snappy, cloak switched off for once -- invisible in the trees, visible on the taskbar, and one hotkey away either way.

dreadlock-hunter-2.alt: Snappy scanning the jungle in heat vision -- cover yourself in mud all you like, the hotkey still finds your app.

dreadlock-hunter-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy, cannon locked on the shoulder -- three red dots on your forehead, one on the launch button.

dreadlock-hunter-nsfw.alt: Snappy shimmering half-invisible, cannon hot -- the jungle goes quiet, then one click. Not a mouse click.

eagle-pad-street-judge.alt: Snappy lays down the law -- I am the launcher.

eagle-pad-street-judge-nsfw.alt: Snappy serves as judge, jury, and one very quick launcher -- sentencing begins immediately.

easter-bunny-flowers.alt: Snappy hugging the prize egg -- it hid a hundred apps across the lawn, and the launcher found them all by breakfast.

easter-bunny-nest.alt: Snappy nestled in hay with ears on -- some apps are harder to find than others.

easter-bunny-wreath.alt: Snappy hopping down the bunny trail -- one basket, one bow, and every app delivered before sunrise.

electric-rat-bulb-suit.alt: Snappy, charged up ever since that prank at school went electric -- one zap, and the app lights up.

emerald-ring-oath-pilot.alt: Snappy, ring raised -- the ring chose it for its will, and that will is set on one hotkey.

engage-crimson.alt: Snappy ordering tea, earl grey, hot -- make it so.

engage-crimson-nsfw.alt: Snappy on an away mission -- the app will be on screen. Engage.

everything-is-fine-coffee-flames.alt: Snappy with a coffee -- this is fine. Everything launches fine.

exiled-duke-ogre-army.alt: Snappy on its hobby horse -- once the ogres get the bouncing berry juice, the castle falls to one keystroke!

exiled-duke-ogre-sidekick.alt: Snappy plotting with its ogre sidekick -- yes, sire! One hotkey, and the castle is ours.

explorer-cartographer.alt: Snappy unrolling the map by torchlight -- here be dragons. And here, one hotkey in, be the app.

exposed-brain-ack-martian.alt: Snappy under the bubble helmet -- ack ack! Ack ack ack! (We come in peace. And with hotkeys.)

exposed-brain-ack-martian-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a retro ray gun -- ack! Ack ack! (Translation: nice launcher, we'll take it.)

eyepatch-calm-twin-sidekick.alt: Snappy, done being anybody's sidekick -- it walked right out of the curve of worlds built around the genius. The hotkey came along.

eyepiece-tubes-assimilator.alt: Snappy with the red-dot eyepiece -- resistance is futile; your apps will be launched.

face-tentacle-lobster-doctor.alt: Snappy waving its claws in a happy scuttle -- woop woop woop! Need a launcher? Why not this one?

feathered-cap-green-tunic-never-grow-up.alt: Snappy, wings on the hips, crowing -- second star to the right and straight on till launch.

feathered-hat-boots-big-pleading-eyes.alt: Snappy clutches its hat with pleading eyes -- how could you close the launcher on this face?

feathered-hat-boots-big-pleading-eyes-ns.alt: Snappy salutes with blade raised -- swashbuckling swordsman by day, this app launches without a single scratch.

fedora-venetian-blind-noir.alt: Snappy behind the blinds -- she walked into my launcher, and I knew it was trouble.

fire-fist-champion.alt: Snappy channeling the dragon within -- your app has been chosen.

fire-fist-champion-nsfw.alt: Snappy chosen to defend the realm -- TEST YOUR MIGHT against this launch.

fire-mage.alt: Snappy, hat brim sparkling, flame in wing -- a wizard is never late. It launches precisely when it means to.

fire-wizard-star.alt: Snappy under the starry hat, staff aglow -- any sufficiently fast hotkey is indistinguishable from magic.

fish-head-admiral-white-uniform.alt: Snappy briefing the fleet by hologram -- it's a trap! Good thing the launcher has a shortcut out.

five-dino-robot-combined.alt: Snappy in the giant robot suit -- dino-mech activated. Launch sequence complete.

flame-paladin.alt: Snappy in armor with the sword tucked away -- protecting every launch without drawing a blade.

flame-paladin-nsfw.alt: Snappy, sword ablaze and shield up -- Deus vult! The crusade against clicking starts with one hotkey.

flame-trousers-spiky-karateka.alt: Snappy carries a curse no one in its bloodline escapes -- back again in the tournament that keeps dragging the same feud into the open.

flaming-skull-chain-nsfw.alt: Snappy in front of its cardboard flames -- look into its eyes and feel every crash you ever caused. Then launch.

flash-pen-black-suit.alt: Snappy holding up the silver pen -- look right here. There was no mouse, only swamp gas from a weather balloon.

flat-top-neck-bolts-dad.alt: Snappy, bolts in, boots on, laughing -- a big goofy family dad who cracks a stair on every step, but never cracks a hotkey.

flat-top-sonic-boom.alt: Snappy, crouched and charging for two whole seconds -- sonic boom! Go home and be a family man, the app is open.

floor-length-hair-bowler.alt: Snappy under a floor of hair -- 'mnmnmnmnm' means the app is open. The family understood every word.

flower-petal-head-upside-down-nsfw.alt: Snappy with its petal head wide open -- straight from the upside down, and the launcher still works there.

fluffy-cat-alien-party-friend.alt: Snappy ready to party -- the fluffy alien needs a moment alone first. Then it launches.

fluffy-furball-gift-box.alt: Snappy wrapped up as a Christmas present -- keep it out of bright light, keep it dry, and never launch after midnight.

fluffy-furball-sitting.alt: Snappy's enormous ears perk up at every little sound -- gentle, harmless, adorable, right up until somebody feeds it after midnight.

fluffy-white-cave-rabbit.alt: Snappy, harmless by the cave -- that's no ordinary owl. It's the most foul, cruel and bad-tempered launcher you ever saw.

fluffy-white-cave-rabbit-nsfw.alt: Snappy, lunging out of the cave -- run away! Then count to three, no more, no less, and press the hotkey. Five is right out.

fly-head-lab-coat-scientist.alt: Snappy's compound eyes catch every angle of the lab -- one small teleportation mishap, and now every launch comes with a buzz.

football-helmet-pogo-stick.alt: Snappy, an eight-year-old genius on a pogo stick -- its rocket is built from soup cans, and one hotkey fires it up.

forest-tunic-hero.alt: Snappy raising its ocarina -- hey! Listen! One little tune, and the app is open.

forest-tunic-hero-nsfw.alt: Snappy raising the blade from the pedestal -- hyaah! Seven years asleep, and the first thing it does is hit the hotkey.

four-armed-arena-champion.alt: Snappy flexing all four arms -- undefeated for five hundred years, and nobody has closed its launcher yet.

four-metal-tentacle-scientist.alt: Snappy with four metal arms -- the power of the sun in the palm of its wing, and it still needs only one hotkey.

friendly-white-ghost-sheet.alt: Snappy under the bedsheet -- it passes straight through walls, doors and every menu on the way to the app.

frilly-clown-balloon.alt: Snappy calling up from the drain -- we all launch down here.

frozen-veil-ninja.alt: Snappy with frost in its feathers -- flawless victory, one frozen launch at a time.

frozen-veil-ninja-nsfw.alt: Snappy, frost in one wing -- the fatality pulls the spine out. The hotkey only pulls the app up.

fur-barbarian-blade.alt: Snappy, fist to the sky -- steel isn't strong, flesh is stronger. And a hotkey is stronger than both.

fur-barbarian-blade-nsfw.alt: Snappy sworn to Crom -- what is best in life? To launch your apps and hear their icons bounce.

fuzzy-owl-toy-batteries.alt: Snappy, fresh out of the box and babbling -- me love you. Me hungry. Me launch app now.

ghost-candy-corn-horn.alt: Snappy on the All-Hallows rounds -- one more doorbell, one more launch.

ghost-mask-phone-caller.alt: Snappy calling while the popcorn pops -- a little quiz: get it right and the app opens. Get it wrong, and it's the mouse.

ghost-witch-hat-candy.alt: Snappy haunting the doorstep -- trick, treat, or launch.

giant-patched-talking-hat.alt: Snappy waiting under the hat -- hmm, difficult. Very difficult. Plenty of courage, a good mind for hotkeys.

gill-fin-swamp-creature.alt: Snappy waving from the lagoon -- they found one fossil claw and sailed up the river for the rest. The app came faster.

glam-sorcerer-crystal-ball.alt: Snappy offering a crystal -- look into it and it will show you your apps. Fear it, love it, press the hotkey.

glam-sorcerer-owl-cane.alt: Snappy twirling an owl-topped cane -- you remind me of the babe. What babe? The babe with the hotkey.

glasses-neighbour-sidekick-kid.alt: Snappy with a stack of books and big glasses -- the clever neighbour already read the launcher manual.

glasses-typewriter-mushroom-house.alt: Snappy, the village know-it-all -- if it's not in the encyclopedia, it doesn't exist. The hotkey is on page one.

goggles-red-hair-taekwondo-rebel.alt: Snappy, goggles up -- the blood talon signs up for the iron fist tournament and finds the one thing it can't outkick: the hotkey.

gold-miner.alt: Snappy digging past the gold for amber -- a bug from the age of dinosaurs, and the old man spared no expense on the launcher.

gold-pepper-pot.alt: Snappy as a pepper pot with a plan -- EXTERMINATE every command that won't launch.

golden-fretful-protocol-droid.alt: Snappy frets in gold plating -- the odds of a clean launch are approximately three thousand seven hundred twenty to one.

good-guy-doll-overalls.alt: Snappy as a good guy through and through -- hi, I'm your launcher, and I'll be your friend till the end.

good-guy-doll-overalls-nsfw.alt: Snappy grinning in the overalls -- the doll that won't stay in the box, and neither will your apps.

good-news-everyone-professor.alt: Snappy with a bubbling flask -- good news, everyone! The launcher works.

gorilla-suit-tiny-skyscraper.alt: Snappy beating its chest atop the little spire -- king of the launchers, undisputed.

goth-sorceress-beehive-bat.alt: Snappy, a villain gone sweet on the masked hero -- midnight dates, love charms, and one hotkey for the app.

great-white-fin-two-note-swim.alt: Snappy, fin up at the beach -- dun-dun... dun-dun... you're gonna need a bigger launcher.

green-alien-anchor-news-desk.alt: Snappy at the news desk with a giant green head -- puny viewers! The hotkeys will be pressed.

green-alien-polka-dot-dress.alt: Snappy, the nicer of the two replicants -- snacks for the family, snacks for the tiny people in the wall, a hotkey for everyone.

green-crested-martian-helmet.alt: Snappy with the space modulator -- where's the kaboom? There was supposed to be an earth-shattering launch.

green-ears-swamp-master.alt: Snappy leans on its cane -- launch or launch not, there is no try.

green-frog-banjo-crooner.alt: Snappy strums the banjo on a log -- someday we'll find it, the rainbow launch connection.

green-fur-electric-mane.alt: Snappy calms down for a second, reaching for a candy bar -- gentle in the jungle, electric at the hotkey.

green-ghost-hotdog-glutton.alt: Snappy with an armful of hot dogs -- it slimed the launcher. It was worth it.

green-glow-movie-star.alt: Snappy convinced it's the best-looking owl in any realm -- those were five-hundred-dollar launches.

green-hair-blue-robe-cliff-walker.alt: Snappy marching off the ledge, umbrella ready -- assign the floater in time, or it's 'oh no!' for the whole launch.

green-marine-pocket-calculator.alt: Snappy with a pocket calculator -- of course it runs on this too, it runs on everything. Rip and tear, then launch.

green-marine-pocket-calculator-nsfw.alt: Snappy, double barrels racked -- IDDQD, IDKFA, and the app pops open before the first imp does.

green-ogre-swamp.alt: Snappy fresh out of the swamp -- launchers are like onions. They have layers.

green-sighing-lieutenant.alt: Snappy blushes somewhere under the green -- it would do anything for the one it loves, including one more launch.

green-skin-broom-ruby-slippers.alt: Snappy eyeing the ruby slippers -- it's melting! Melting! Oh, what a world, and what a fast launcher.

green-spandex-gold-shield.alt: Snappy playing the dagger flute in green and gold -- one tune, and the dragonzord... er, the app appears.

green-suction-arm-friendly-pet.alt: Snappy, the nice one of the two brothers -- it doesn't want to rule the world, just a record deal and a faster launch.

green-vneck-sandwich-slacker.alt: Snappy with a sandwich taller than itself -- like, zoinks, man, launch the app and let's get outta here!

grey-blue-cat-frying-pan-chase.alt: Snappy, frying pan hidden behind its back -- eighty years chasing the same mouse. This launcher simply stopped using one.

grey-rabbit-carrot-whats-up.alt: Snappy, chomping a carrot -- eh, what's up, doc? It knew it should've taken that left hotkey at Albuquerque.

grey-wing-hair-karate-elder.alt: Snappy, fist crackling -- blown up in its own temple, back in time to host the next tournament. The launcher never even needed a reboot.

grinning-striped-cat-fading.alt: Snappy, vanishing tail first -- until only the grin and the hotkey remain. We're all mad here.

grumpy-bread-loaf.alt: Snappy, a thoroughly fed-up loaf -- mist! It only wanted to be left alone, and instead the launcher runs it all night on a loop.

grumpy-green-trash-can.alt: Snappy peeks out of the trash can -- scram! Unless you brought a shortcut.

half-and-half-merge-conflict.alt: Snappy split right down the middle -- automatic merge failed; fix the conflicts, then launch the result.

half-eggshell-hat-chick.alt: Snappy with half the shell still on its head -- they launched the big apps first, and that's an injustice, it is!

half-white-mask-opera-cape.alt: Snappy with a rose and a sweeping cape -- the launcher of the opera is there, inside your mind.

halloween-witch-lantern.alt: Snappy carrying a jack-o-lantern into the night -- the glow never dims.

halloween-witch-pumpkins.alt: Snappy amid carved pumpkins -- trick or launch.

hawaiian-shirt-quiff-animal-sleuth.alt: Snappy, with a parrot on its head -- the hotkey fits laaaike a glove! Alrighty then, app launched.

heart-gown-flamingo-mallet.alt: Snappy with the flamingo mallet -- off with its load time!

hellfire-specter.alt: Snappy from beyond the grave -- get over here, there's an app to launch.

hellfire-specter-2.alt: Snappy in the gold mask -- it used to be a man with a family and a garden. Now it has a grudge and a hotkey.

hellfire-specter-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy rising from the flames, kunai on its chain -- choose your destiny: novice, warrior, master, or just the hotkey.

hellfire-specter-3.alt: Snappy stepping out of the flames, fist first -- round one... fight! The app launched halfway through the announcement.

hellfire-specter-3-nsfw.alt: Snappy swinging the chain of vengeance -- every app answers when summoned.

hellfire-specter-nsfw.alt: Snappy reaching across the void -- GET OVER HERE and face the launcher.

helmet-three-sizes-too-big.alt: Snappy in an absurdly oversized black helmet -- surrounded by apps, and this launch has gone to plaid.

hockey-mask-slasher.alt: Snappy behind the hockey mask -- ch-ch-ch... the launcher is already running.

hockey-mask-slasher-nsfw.alt: Snappy behind a hockey mask -- ch-ch-ch, launch-launch-launch.

hockey-mask-sports-bag-vigilante.alt: Snappy with a golf bag of sticks and rackets -- goongala! The vigilante of the launcher.

honking-goose-stolen-hat.alt: Snappy, hat under a wing -- a lovely morning in the village, and it is a horrible launcher. Every gardener annoyed.

hooded-blade-bearer.alt: Snappy perched on the highest tower -- one leap of faith into the haystack, one hotkey into the app.

hooded-blade-bearer-nsfw.alt: Snappy leaping from a rooftop -- nothing is true, everything is launchable.

hooded-force-wanderer.alt: Snappy under the hood, hilt on the belt -- the mouse? Now that's a name it hasn't heard in a long time. A long time.

hooded-reaper-hourglass.alt: Snappy with the sand running through the hourglass -- challenge it to chess if you like, the app has already launched.

hooded-reaper-scythe-nsfw.alt: Snappy dropping in on the dinner party -- it was the salmon mousse. The app, meanwhile, launched just fine.

hooded-skeleton-kitten-curry.alt: Snappy, kitten cradled in a bone hand -- IT WOULD NOT DREAM OF HARMING A CAT. THE MOUSE CLICK, THOUGH, HAS HAD ITS TIME.

horned-hair-witch-telescope.alt: Snappy peering down through the telescope -- after ten thousand years, it's free! Time to conquer every app on the planet.

horned-red-robot-golden-fiddle.alt: Snappy playing the golden fiddle -- a golden fiddle against your soul, and the wager is who launches first. The house always wins.

horned-trickster.alt: Snappy burdened with glorious purpose -- and that purpose is launching apps.

horned-trickster-2.alt: Snappy with the cube in both wings -- it never wanted the throne. It only ever wanted to be your equal. And your hotkey.

horned-trickster-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy, scepter glowing over the crowd -- kneel! Is this not simpler? You were made to be ruled. By hotkeys.

huggable-inflatable-nurse.alt: Snappy fully inflated and ready to hug -- hello, I am your personal launch companion.

hyperkinetic-rabbity-thing-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a very large revolver -- ooh, can I shoot something? No? Then I'll launch something instead!

ice-hockey-goalie-camp-mask.alt: Snappy in goal, mask on -- ki ki ki, ma ma ma... launch! Every shot at summer camp saved.

icing-gumdrop-gingerbread.alt: Snappy as a gingerbread cookie -- run, run, as fast as a launch.

infinity-gauntlet-titan.alt: Snappy waving with the gauntlet wide open -- perfectly balanced, as all launchers should be.

infinity-gauntlet-titan-nsfw.alt: Snappy raising a gem-studded gauntlet -- with a snap, half your open apps are gone.

inkblot-mask-trench.alt: Snappy's journal, October 12th -- the apps will look up and shout 'launch us!', and it will whisper 'use the hotkey.'

iron-circuit.alt: Snappy in glowing power armor -- built in a cave, with a box of scraps.

iron-circuit-2.alt: Snappy with the faceplate up and the chest core humming -- genius, billionaire, launcher, philanthropist.

iron-fist-brawler.alt: Snappy, metal fists up -- it catches the mouse mid-jump and drops it across one knee. Backbreaker, then launch.

iron-mask-green-hood-monarch.alt: Snappy in the riveted iron mask -- the launcher bows to no one. Except the hotkey.

jade-giant-rage.alt: Snappy gone jade and furious -- you wouldn't like this owl when it's angry.

jagged-teeth-arm-blade-mutant.alt: Snappy in the spiky grey hood -- foot soldier of the emperor's horde, and the only one in it that owns a hotkey.

jagged-teeth-arm-blade-mutant-nsfw.alt: Snappy, both blades out -- lifted, skewered, done. The mouse learns what the fatality was for. The app just gets the hotkey.

jaguar-mask-wrestler.alt: Snappy under the jaguar jaws -- it took the murdered champion's mask and fights the fist tournament for the orphans. One growl, one launch.

jester-toy-maker-villain.alt: Snappy the jester with a banana puppet -- playtime! The banana says: press the hotkey.

kilt-tam-rival-tycoon.alt: Snappy stroking the big black beard -- second-richest launcher in the world, and scheming.

knitting-tweed-village-sleuth.alt: Snappy knits and listens -- in a village this small, nobody launches anything unnoticed.

lamp-and-staff-explorer.alt: Snappy with the lantern on the staff -- a journey of a thousand apps begins with a single hotkey.

late-pocket-watch-rabbit.alt: Snappy dashing off, watch in wing -- it's late, it's late, for a very important launch! No time to say hello, goodbye.

lazy-orange-tabby-lasagna.alt: Snappy with a whole tray of lasagna -- it hates Mondays, but it loves a quick launch.

leather-jacket-night-shift-vampire.alt: Snappy on the night shift -- it wants to be mortal again, but until then: no daylight, no garlic, no mouse.

leather-jacket-night-shift-vampire-car-t.alt: Snappy rising from the car trunk at sunset -- the car is a coffin, the bottle is not wine, the hotkey is on duty.

leather-mask-chainsaw-nsfw.alt: Snappy revving the chainsaw -- who will survive, and what will be left of the start menu?

leggy-crab-parasite-hat.alt: Snappy staggers out of the test chamber, arms stiff -- something went wrong with the experiment, but the launch still went right.

leopard-print-tall-blond-radio-host.alt: Snappy live on the mic -- bzzz! Green! Super green! The launcher is hot, hot, HOT!

light-blue-alien-wall-terrarium.alt: Snappy taps the glass at its tiny wall-town -- every little resident cheers when the app launches.

lightbulb-helper-inventor.alt: Snappy with the lightbulb assistant on its shoulder -- the little helper has an idea. It lights up. The app launches.

lightning-bolt-scarlet-2.alt: Snappy mid-stride -- to the outside world, an ordinary forensic scientist. Secretly, it launches apps faster than you can blink.

lightning-streak-beehive-bride.alt: Snappy with the lightning-streaked beehive -- she's alive, and she wants a faster launcher.

lime-alien-orange-shirt-loves-earth.alt: Snappy, bucket in one wing, soda in the other -- it fled a dying planet and stayed for the drive-thru. And the launcher.

liquid-metal-blade.alt: Snappy pulling itself back together out of a chrome puddle -- it can imitate anything it touches, even your favourite hotkey.

liquid-metal-blade-nsfw.alt: Snappy as the next-model hunter -- the launcher can't be bargained with, can't be reasoned with, and absolutely will not stop.

llama-headphones-spectrum-bars.alt: Snappy, headphones on, bobbing to the green bars -- it really whips the llama's a**.

long-coat-blue-scarf-modern.alt: Snappy, coat collar up -- it's not a mouse user, it's a high-functioning hotkey user. Do your research.

long-coat-hat-streetlamp-priest.alt: Snappy under the streetlamp with its bag -- the most famous house call in film. Launch the power of Christ... er, the app.

long-wet-hair-tv-well-girl.alt: Snappy climbing out of the old TV -- seven days. Or one hotkey, whichever comes first.

loudest-knitted-jumper.alt: Snappy in the loudest jumper at the party -- it jingles with every keystroke, and no launcher dares show up uglier.

magic-compass-captain.alt: Snappy with a compass that doesn't point north -- it points to the app you want most. Savvy?

marzipan-lucky-pig.alt: Snappy as a marzipan lucky pig -- Schwein gehabt! A happy new year and a lucky first launch.

masked-walkman-outlaw.alt: Snappy with an awesome mix on the belt -- a legendary outlaw, hooked on a feeling for hotkeys.

masked-walkman-outlaw-nsfw.alt: Snappy dancing to the awesome mix, blaster in wing -- never heard of it? A legendary outlaw, and a legendary launcher.

metal-beak-rooster-agent.alt: Snappy flashing the steel beak -- it bites through prison bars and bank vaults, and clean through slow menus.

mighty-pirate-wannabe-rubber-chicken.alt: Snappy, a mighty pirate -- look behind you, a three-headed monkey! Too late, the app already launched.

monocle-top-hat-umbrella-waddle.alt: Snappy leaning on one of its trick umbrellas -- one turns into a parachute, one into a helicopter, and one launches the app.

motion-tracker-cargo-pants.alt: Snappy watches the tracker ping -- they're coming outta the walls, one hotkey each.

motion-tracker-cargo-pants-nsfw.alt: Snappy, rifle across the chest -- nuke the site from orbit? It's the only way to be sure. Or press the hotkey, that works too.

mouse-ears-deerstalker-cape.alt: Snappy with the magnifier -- a mouse detective, and still it swears by the hotkey.

moustache-fencer-six-fingers.alt: Snappy bows politely -- hello, my name is Snappy. You pressed the hotkey. Prepare to launch.

moustache-fencer-six-fingers-nsfw.alt: Snappy, rapier raised, eyes narrowed -- hello. My name is Snappy. You closed my launcher. Prepare to relaunch.

mullet-duct-tape-fixer.alt: Snappy, locked in with a paperclip and duct tape -- ninety seconds later it has built a launcher. No guns, just hotkeys.

multipass-cabbie.alt: Snappy flashing a multipass -- negative, this owl is a meat popsicle.

multipass-cabbie-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a multipass and a blaster -- anyone else want to negotiate?

multipass-supreme.alt: Snappy the supreme being -- launcher-Dallas-multipass, big ba-da boom.

muzzle-mask-hand-truck.alt: Snappy strapped to the hand truck -- a census taker once tried a mouse. It launched with fava beans and a nice chianti.

nail-grid-leather-priest-nsfw.alt: Snappy clicking the golden cube's last panel into place -- the bell tolls, the walls split, and the chains come for whoever still uses a mouse.

nakatomi-ho-ho-ho.alt: Snappy barefoot on the carpet after a long flight -- make fists with your toes, then press the hotkey.

nakatomi-ho-ho-ho-2.alt: Snappy squeezing through the air vent, lighter in beak -- now it knows what a TV dinner feels like. The app is already warm.

nakatomi-ho-ho-ho-3.alt: Snappy spoiling a very expensive heist -- yippee-ki-yay, launcher.

newyear-champagne-pop.alt: Snappy popping the cork at midnight -- the first launch of the year always goes off with a bang.

nightcap-candle-humbug.alt: Snappy, scowling at the chain -- three visitors tonight: launches past, present and yet to come. Bah, humbug!

nightgown-tv-static-theyre-here.alt: Snappy at the static screen -- they're heeere. And they want the launcher.

ninja.alt: Snappy dressed all in black in broad daylight -- nobody sees it move, nobody hears a click. The app just opens.

ninja-nsfw.alt: Snappy vanishing in a puff of smoke -- the app was launched before you even noticed.

obsidian-panther.alt: Snappy of the hidden kingdom -- forever, forever, and every launch.

offline-pixel-dino-cactus.alt: Snappy, pixelated next to a cactus -- no internet? Press space to jump. The launcher works offline anyway.

one-eyed-green-ball-scarer.alt: Snappy, one big eye, clipboard ready -- scary feet, scary feet, scary feet... the kid's awake! And the app is open.

one-sleeve-leather-wasteland-driver.alt: Snappy with its dog and a tin of dog food -- the last of the V8 launchers, running on hotkeys, not guzzoline.

one-sleeve-leather-wasteland-driver-nsfw.alt: Snappy, one leather sleeve -- the road warrior of launchers, running on the last drop of fuel.

ook-orangutan-librarian.alt: Snappy with an armful of books -- ook. Call it a monkey once and it will launch you out of the library.

orange-ascot-ghost-sleuth.alt: Snappy with a rope and a plan for a trap -- let's split up, gang, and unmask that app once and for all.

orange-bandana-cowabunga-shell-hero.alt: Snappy with an open pizza box -- pizza first, training second, and the app launches somewhere in between.

orange-cat-lasagna-parody-alien.alt: Snappy with an alien-sized lasagna -- feed me, launcher. I hate Mondays in every dimension.

orange-crab-fearless.alt: Snappy, claws up -- fearless launches, and the borrow checker approved every hotkey.

orange-hair-lab-meep.alt: Snappy holding up the test flask -- meep? Meep meep! Translation: the launch worked this time.

orange-marsupial-jeans-fruit.alt: Snappy holding up the fruit -- whoa! Spin through the crates, grab a hundred, launch an extra life.

orange-mouse-brown-ears.alt: Snappy blinks under the big brown ears -- that was a launch, and now: the explanation.

orange-mustache-fluffy-tree-guardian.alt: Snappy standing on the stump -- it speaks for the trees, and the trees would like a faster launcher.

orange-turtleneck-lost-glasses.alt: Snappy squinting through thick frames -- jinkies! It can't find a thing without its launcher.

oversized-top-hat-tea-party.alt: Snappy under the huge top hat -- it's always six o'clock here, always tea-time, always launch time.

owl-post-letter.alt: Snappy checking the return address twice -- cupboard under the stairs or not, the launch always finds you.

pac-dome-suit.alt: Snappy chasing the high score -- wakka-wakka, pellet, launch.

padded-muscle-suit-flex.alt: Snappy, foam muscles pumped -- that's its secret: it's always angry. And always one hotkey away.

pale-black-mane-sand-pouch-helm.alt: Snappy, after a century in a glass cage -- first it takes back its pouch, its helm and its ruby. Then its hotkey.

pale-mask-boilersuit.alt: Snappy standing silent under the street lamp -- it's Halloween, everyone's entitled to one good launch.

pale-mask-boilersuit-nsfw.alt: Snappy standing very still with a kitchen knife -- it never runs, it never speaks, and it still gets to your app first.

panda-suit-dumpling-skadoosh.alt: Snappy with a steamer full of dumplings -- skadoosh! Inner peace, hotkey in, app out.

paper-moon-rocket-in-the-eye.alt: Snappy as the silent-film moon -- the first launch in cinema history, and it landed right in the eye.

paperclip-assistant-eyebrows.alt: Snappy popping up uninvited -- it looks like you're trying to launch an app. Would you like help with that?

party.alt: Snappy blowing the party horn, glass raised -- tonight it's gonna launch like it's 1999.

party-worm-sunglasses.alt: Snappy the party worm with shades -- wimmy wham wham wozzle! Party's on, apps are open.

penguin-kernel-suit.alt: Snappy, well fed and waddling -- this is finally the year of the desktop, and the launcher is ready for it.

perfect-organism.alt: Snappy as the perfect organism -- in space, no one can hear the launcher.

perfect-organism-2.alt: Snappy, tail curled around its feet -- one drop of its blood eats through three decks. One press of the hotkey eats the whole wait.

pink-armour-flute-cat.alt: Snappy, flute at the beak -- the tune is lovely right up until someone calls it kitty. Then it's launch time.

pink-bunny-pajama-suit.alt: Snappy in the pink nightmare from the aunt -- a deranged Easter bunny that still launches like an official model.

pink-bunny-pajama-suit-nsfw.alt: Snappy proud of its air rifle, one lens cracked -- you'll shoot your eye out, kid. Nearly did. The app launched anyway.

pink-cool-cat-tiptoe-nsfw.alt: Snappy, holder lit -- the painter wanted blue, the panther wanted pink, and the house ended up pink. So did the launch.

pink-heart-grey-cube.alt: Snappy, weighted and loyal -- it will never threaten to stab you, and in fact cannot speak. It can launch, though.

pink-jumpsuit-shape-mask-guard.alt: Snappy in the pink jumpsuit with the circle mask -- red light, green light, hotkey.

pink-spandex-dino-wave.alt: Snappy in pink with a wave -- pterodactyl power! And a hotkey on the side.

pink-tracksuit-intern.alt: Snappy in the pink tracksuit -- the richest intern in the universe, and its favourite tool is a free hotkey.

pinky-bald-villain-cat.alt: Snappy, feather tip to the beak -- we will launch your app for... one MILLION hotkeys.

pinstripe-skeleton-bat-bowtie.alt: Snappy in pinstripes with a jack-o'-lantern -- tired of the same old scares, it went looking for something new and found a hotkey.

pinstripe-zf1.alt: Snappy with a dish of cherries -- mind the pits, it nearly choked on one mid-speech. The hotkey never chokes.

pinstripe-zf1-nsfw.alt: Snappy the weapons magnate -- dahling, a little destruction encourages a lot of launches.

pirate.alt: Snappy, spyglass to the good eye -- land ho! One hotkey, and the app is in port.

pirate-nsfw.alt: Snappy flying the jolly roger -- X marks the launch target.

pixel-gamer-king.alt: Snappy chasing the high score -- it's measured in apps launched per minute.

pizzeria-boss-rhyme-cat.alt: Snappy with a fresh pizza on the peel -- the boss of the shop says: hot pizza, fast app, that's a wrap.

planet-brain-dome-robot.alt: Snappy with a planet where the brain should be -- brain the size of a planet, and they ask it to launch apps. Call that job satisfaction?

plant-mutant-flower-scientist.alt: Snappy, fresh from the photosynthesis experiment -- it grew leaves to win a date. Now it runs on sunlight and one hotkey.

plumed-demon-mask-samurai.alt: Snappy sits cross-legged mid-fight to meditate its wounds shut -- a strange habit that still wins the biggest unofficial championship around.

plumed-demon-mask-samurai-nsfw.alt: Snappy, blade drawn -- one tournament for the iron fist, another for the soul-eating sword, and it turns up to both. The app opens on one key.

pointed-ears-blue-science.alt: Snappy with one eyebrow raised -- launching exactly the right app is only logical.

pompom-topknot-woven-blanket.alt: Snappy in fluffy alpaca wool -- calm, content, and ready to launch.

ponytail-cop-snake-stance.alt: Snappy is undercover chasing a crime syndicate again, cuffs ready -- five borrowed styles, one entry in a tournament everyone whispers about.

porcelain-doll-glass-case.alt: Snappy sitting still in the glass case -- do not open. Unless you need a launcher.

pork-pie-chemist.alt: Snappy cooking something blue in the lab -- say my name. I am the one who launches.

potato-farmer-space-duct-tape.alt: Snappy grows its own potatoes -- time to science the heck out of this launch.

power-glove-hacking-time.alt: Snappy at the beige keyboard -- it's hacking time! Uh-oh, one hotkey and it hacked too much time.

proton-pack-buster.alt: Snappy ready for spectral containment -- it has the tools, it has the talent, and it has a hotkey.

proton-pack-buster-2.alt: Snappy with the meter beeping wildly -- listen, do you smell something? A launch, already done.

proton-pack-buster-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy running hot on the containment grid -- the P.K.E. meter is off the charts.

proton-pack-buster-3.alt: Snappy holding the trap shut -- whatever you do, don't look directly into the trap. It looked. The app still launched.

proton-pack-buster-3-nsfw.alt: Snappy crossing the streams -- total protonic reversal never stopped a good launch.

proton-pack-buster-4.alt: Snappy warning of a disaster of biblical proportions -- dogs and cats living together, mass hysteria! Or one hotkey.

proton-pack-buster-4-nsfw.alt: Snappy geared for heavy spectral ops -- when someone asks if you're a launcher, you say yes.

proton-pack-buster-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a proton pack -- it got slimed on the way in, and it still launched first.

pumpkin-head-hobby-horse-rider.alt: Snappy at full gallop, pumpkin aloft -- you can't reason with a headless owl, and you can't outclick a hotkey.

pumpkin-head-hobby-horse-rider-nsfw.alt: Snappy charging on a hobby horse, sabre raised -- the legend says the horseman stops at the bridge. The launch stops nowhere.

pumpkin-head-under-arm-rider.alt: Snappy with its own head tucked under a wing -- the hessian rides again, hunting for a lost head and a free hotkey.

pumpkin-head-under-arm-rider-nsfw.alt: Snappy raising a sabre, pumpkin under a wing -- run for the covered bridge all you like, the pumpkin launches first.

pumpkin-lantern-dark-horse-rider.alt: Snappy, lantern glowing at its side -- the ghost story every farmer tells at the harvest dance, and the one that ends with a launch.

pumpkin-lantern-dark-horse-rider-nsfw.alt: Snappy, lantern low, sabre high -- ride as hard as you like, nobody in the hollow outruns this launch.

purple-bandana-gadget-shell-hero.alt: Snappy shows off its homemade gadget -- built from sewer junk, and it still launches faster than the brothers' van.

purple-caped-masked-mallard.alt: Snappy bursting out of a smoke cloud -- it is the terror that flaps in the night. Let's get dangerous, and launch!

purple-caped-masked-mallard-gargoyle-per.alt: Snappy on a gargoyle under the crescent moon -- I am the fly in the ointment, the hotkey in your launcher!

purple-caped-masked-mallard-smoke-leap.alt: Snappy leaping out of purple smoke -- suck gas, evildoers! The app is open before the smoke clears.

warthog-punk-mohawk-shades.alt: Snappy with a purple mohawk and red shades -- duh, which hotkey launches the green guys in shells?

water-dog-salesman-villain.alt: Snappy the water dog in a blue suit -- this launcher comes with a money-back guarantee! Satisfaction guaranteed.

waxed-moustache-little-grey-cells.alt: Snappy beside the train stuck in the snow -- twelve suspects, one app, and every single one of them pressed the hotkey.

werewolf.alt: Snappy after an unfortunate bite -- sharper claws, same love of launching.

werewolf-moon.alt: Snappy howling at the full moon -- even lycanthropy can't stop a good launch.

whale-stacked-containers.alt: Snappy hauls a stack of containers -- ships the app to any machine, launches it on yours.

whip-and-skull-torch.alt: Snappy on the trail -- fortune and glory, kid. Fortune and glory.

whip-and-torch-explorer.alt: Snappy on a relic hunt -- apps. Why did it have to be apps?

white-armour-samurai-cat-leader.alt: Snappy in white samurai armour with a pizza box -- pizza delivered, cat's eye launch!

white-gi-red-headband-fireball.alt: Snappy, wings thrust forward -- down, down-forward, forward, punch: the oldest shortcut there is. Hadouken!

white-hooded-crescent-avenger.alt: Snappy watching over night travelers under a full moon -- several personalities, and each one has its own hotkey.

white-hooded-crescent-avenger-nsfw.alt: Snappy, crescent darts flying -- summon the suit, summon the hotkey, and sort out whose turn it is later.

white-mask-snake-braid-matador.alt: Snappy, mask firmly on -- nobody touches this face. Not the mouse, not a click. Only the hotkey is allowed near.

white-mask-snake-braid-matador-nsfw.alt: Snappy, claw in one wing, rose in the other -- the rose is for beautiful things, the claw for ugly ones. The mouse got the claw.

white-mohawk-green-prankster.alt: Snappy's mohawk bristles with mischief -- give this one a puddle and a midnight snack, and the whole launch multiplies.

white-plastoid-trooper.alt: Snappy with its helmet off, far from its post -- it can't hit a single target, but it never misses a hotkey.

white-plastoid-trooper-nsfw.alt: Snappy, blaster aimed a little wide -- no need to see its identification. Move along, move along, the app is open.

wide-hat-monk.alt: Snappy tired of being second best -- the hat trick lands before the app does.

wide-hat-monk-2.alt: Snappy holds a calm stance before the spin -- the launcher already knows how sharp this app's day is about to get.

wild-hair-flux-capacitor.alt: Snappy, staring at the glowing gadget in its case -- 1.21 jigowatts?! The hotkey runs on a lot less.

winged-helm-hammer.alt: Snappy raising the drinking horn -- this launcher, it likes it. Another!

winged-helm-hammer-nsfw.alt: Snappy the rightful wielder -- whosoever be worthy shall launch the apps.

wolf-pelt-mask-forest-princess.alt: Snappy riding with the wolves of the forest -- it sees with eyes unclouded by hate, and launches the same way.

wolf-pelt-mask-forest-princess-wolf-pup.alt: Snappy and the littlest wolf -- raised by the wolf goddess, it swears it's no human. And no mouse user either.

wormhole-gun-spring-boots.alt: Snappy fresh out of the test chamber -- the cake is a lie, but the launch is real.

wormhole-gun-spring-boots-2.alt: Snappy turned itself into a pickle -- funniest launch you have ever seen.

wormhole-gun-spring-boots-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy, a pickle storming the spy agency's tower -- every guard down, one grim new ally from the cells, and a portal straight to the app.

wrinkled-snout-furry-alien.alt: Snappy eyeing the family cat -- no problem! It's saving the cat for dinner and the hotkey for now.

yellow-chomping-ghost.alt: Snappy chomping through a maze -- wakka wakka wakka, app launched.

yellow-chomping-ghost-2.alt: Snappy after the power pellet -- the ghosts never stood a chance against a quick launch.

yellow-jacket-everything-connected.alt: Snappy, corgi under one wing -- not a psychic, a holistic detective. The universe told it to press the hotkey.

yellow-raincoat-paper-boat.alt: Snappy in the yellow raincoat -- the paper boat floats, the red balloon floats, and the launcher floats too.

yellow-shirt-anxious-sidekick.alt: Snappy wringing its wings in a yellow shirt -- aw jeez, I-I don't know about this launcher.

yellow-spandex-dino-kick.alt: Snappy in yellow in a martial-arts guard -- sabre-tooth tiger power, launched.

yellow-tracksuit-black-stripe.alt: Snappy in the yellow tracksuit -- those of you lucky enough to still have your apps, launch them. The mouse clicks you've lost belong to it now.

yellow-tracksuit-black-stripe-nsfw.alt: Snappy with the sword in both wings -- if on its journey it should meet a mouse, the mouse will be cut.

yellow-trench-wrist-radio.alt: Snappy, square jaw set, one wing pointing -- crimestoppers' textbook, lesson one: a good detective never clicks through menus.

yellow-zoot-suit-green-hood.alt: Snappy tipping its hat, green and grinning -- ssssmokin'! It's party time, and every app is invited.

yoga-skull-beads-flame.alt: Snappy, floating in meditation -- yoga fire! Yoga teleport! And it's already inside the app.

young-dragon-volcano-crater.alt: Snappy, fresh out of the volcano -- ich will dir fressen! Grammar still wrong, launch still right.

zombie-brain-buffet.alt: Snappy wrapped in torn bandages -- a zombie process: exited long ago, still in the table. The launcher reaps it and moves on.

zombie-brain-buffet-nsfw.alt: Snappy risen hungry -- braaains... and launcheeees...

zombie-pirate-black-beard.alt: Snappy, the zombie pirate in love -- you can't escape, my love! Not from me and not from this hotkey.
